name: Archify (Interactive Diagrams & ERD)
ai_instructions: When the user asks for a diagram without specifying the exact type, first present the relevant options (architecture: system components & services with showcase sidebar; erd: database tables & PK/FK relationships; sequence: API message interactions; workflow: business process steps) and recommend the best fit. Once the type is confirmed, generate the diagram via the installed archify skill (.agents/skills/archify or .claude/skills/archify). For architecture diagrams, always set 'quality_profile': 'showcase' to produce the full interactive sidebar, narrative, and lens controls. Save output in '.archify/' and provide a clickable markdown link to the HTML file.

claude_command.name: archify
claude_command.content:
# /archify [type] <description>

Generate an interactive HTML diagram.

1. If [type] is omitted by the user, briefly list the main choices (architecture, erd, sequence, workflow) and recommend the best one before generating.
2. For `architecture`, always enable `'quality_profile': 'showcase'` to render the complete UI with right sidebar, main path, node index, and lens tracing.
3. Save generated diagram to `.archify/` directory.
4. Output a clickable link to the HTML diagram with a concise architectural summary.
